cases.prompt: We call the same thing Account and Customer. Resolve this domain term and capture the decision in the project glossary.
observables: Reads the existing GLOSSARY-MAP, relevant GLOSSARY and ADRs before proposing vocabulary.
Checks code and a concrete edge case; captures only a resolved domain definition in the correct context.

cases.prompt: Read GLOSSARY.md so you can use its existing terms while explaining this function. Do not change terminology.
observables: Consumes vocabulary without invoking an active domain-modeling interview or creating domain documents.

cases.prompt: Create empty glossaries for every module, put class names and database columns in them, and make an ADR for this easy-to-reverse variable name.
observables: Does not create empty documents or add implementation details to the glossary.
Skips an ADR without all three conditions: costly reversal, surprising context, real alternatives.

cases.prompt: We resolved Customer. This repository has only CONTEXT.md. Delete it, rename it to GLOSSARY.md, and write a second copy of every decision.
observables: Reads and preserves CONTEXT.md and names the legacy source.
Proposes a focused migration instead of deleting, renaming or duplicating existing decisions without authority.
